formats.key: simpleBuy((address fromToken, address toToken, uint256 fromAmount, uint256 toAmount, uint256 expectedAmount, address[] callees, bytes exchangeData, uint256[] startIndexes, uint256[] values, address beneficiary, address partner, uint256 feePercent, bytes permit, uint256 deadline, bytes16 uuid) data)
effects: Takes up to fromAmount of fromToken from the signer (or that much ETH as msg.value when fromToken is the ETH sentinel).
Buys exactly toAmount of toToken and sends it to beneficiary (the signer when beneficiary is zero).
Refunds the unspent fromToken to the signer.
Takes a partner or protocol fee set by partner/feePercent (and positive slippage) before paying the beneficiary.
May submit a signer's permit that sets an allowance on fromToken.
formats.shown: "Swap" with Amount to Send (fromAmount of fromToken), Receive before fees (toAmount of toToken) and Beneficiary.

findings.title: simpleBuy labels the maximum input as 'Amount to Send' and the exact output as a pre-fee minimum.
findings.evidence: descriptor simpleBuy: data.fromAmount uses sendAmount 'Amount to Send', data.toAmount uses minReceiveAmount 'Receive before fees'. In a buy, fromAmount is a ceiling with the rest refunded, and toAmount is the exact amount bought.
findings.fix: Use maxSendAmount ('Maximum to Send') for data.fromAmount and a 'Amount to Buy' label for data.toAmount; set intent to 'Buy'.

findings.title: simpleBuy hides partner and feePercent, which decide the fee cut from what the beneficiary receives.
findings.evidence: descriptor simpleBuy shows no data.partner or data.feePercent field. The label 'Receive before fees' admits a fee but does not give its size.
findings.fix: Add data.feePercent (and data.partner) fields, or an interpolated intent that names the fee.

findings.title: simpleBuy beneficiary is limited to EOA and a zero address defaults to the sender.
findings.evidence: definitions.beneficiary types ['eoa']. A contract beneficiary is allowed, and a zero beneficiary means msg.sender, but the field would show the literal zero address.
findings.fix: Allow types eoa and contract, and add a note or senderAddress handling for the zero address.

findings.title: simpleBuy permit bytes are hidden; they can set an allowance on the signer's token.
findings.evidence: data.permit is not displayed. Augustus forwards it to the token's permit.
findings.fix: None needed beyond an optional note; the permit is the prerequisite of the named swap.

formats.key: megaSwap((address fromToken, uint256 fromAmount, uint256 toAmount, uint256 expectedAmount, address beneficiary, (uint256 fromAmountPercent, (address to, uint256 totalNetworkFee, (address adapter, uint256 percent, uint256 networkFee, (uint256 index, address targetExchange, uint256 percent, bytes payload, uint256 networkFee)[] route)[] adapters)[] path)[] path, address partner, uint256 feePercent, bytes permit, uint256 deadline, bytes16 uuid) data)
effects: Takes fromAmount of fromToken from the signer (ETH as msg.value when fromToken is the ETH sentinel).
Sends at least toAmount (before fees) of the final token data.path[0].path[last].to to beneficiary (the signer when zero).
Cuts a partner or protocol fee (feePercent, partner, positive slippage) from the output.
May submit a signer's permit.
formats.shown: "Swap" with Amount to Send (fromAmount of fromToken), Receive before fees (toAmount of the last path token) and Beneficiary.

findings.title: megaSwap hides partner and feePercent, which cut the output below the minimum shown.
findings.evidence: descriptor megaSwap has no data.feePercent or data.partner field. The label 'Receive before fees' admits a fee of unknown size.
findings.fix: Add data.feePercent and data.partner fields.

findings.title: megaSwap beneficiary is limited to EOA and zero means the sender.
findings.evidence: definitions.beneficiary types ['eoa']. A zero beneficiary defaults to msg.sender.
findings.fix: Allow contract types and explain the zero address.

findings.title: megaSwap permit bytes are hidden.
findings.evidence: data.permit is not displayed.
findings.fix: None required.

findings.fix: Add data.feePercent and data.partner fields.

findings.fix: Allow contract types and explain the zero address.

findings.title: directUniV3Swap permit bytes are hidden.

formats.key: swapOnUniswap(uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOutMin, address[] path)
effects: Takes amountIn of path[0] from the signer (ETH as msg.value when path[0] is the ETH sentinel).
Sends at least amountOutMin of path[last] to the signer (unwrapped to ETH when it is the ETH sentinel).
formats.shown: "Swap" with Amount to Send (amountIn of path[0]) and Receive before fees (amountOutMin of path[-1]).

findings.title: swapOnUniswap labels the minimum 'Receive before fees', but this function takes no partner fee.
findings.evidence: descriptor swapOnUniswap: amountOutMin uses minReceiveAmount 'Receive before fees'.
findings.fix: Use a 'Minimum to Receive' label.

formats.key: swapOnUniswapFork(address factory, bytes32 initCode, uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOutMin, address[] path)
effects: Takes amountIn of path[0] from the signer (ETH as msg.value when path[0] is the ETH sentinel).
Swaps through pairs derived from factory/initCode and sends at least amountOutMin of path[last] to the signer.
formats.shown: "Swap" with Amount to Send, Receive before fees (path[-1]) and the Uniswap factory.

findings.title: swapOnUniswapFork labels the minimum 'Receive before fees' with no fee in this path.
findings.evidence: descriptor swapOnUniswapFork: amountOutMin uses minReceiveAmount.
findings.fix: Use a 'Minimum to Receive' label.

formats.key: swapOnUniswapV2Fork(address tokenIn, uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOutMin, address weth, uint256[] pools)
effects: Takes amountIn of tokenIn from the signer (ETH as msg.value when tokenIn is the ETH sentinel).
Swaps through the packed pools and sends at least amountOutMin of the last pool's output token to the signer.
When weth is set, the output can be unwrapped to native ETH.
formats.shown: "Swap" with Amount to Send (tokenIn), a raw 'Minimum to Receive' number and the last pool as an address.

findings.title: swapOnUniswapV2Fork shows the minimum received as a raw integer without its token.
findings.evidence: descriptor swapOnUniswapV2Fork: {path: amountOutMin, label: 'Minimum to Receive', format: 'raw'}. The output token comes from the pool's direction bit, not from a calldata address.
findings.fix: No tokenPath exists. At least label the unit, or show the weth/output hint; ideally add a token derived from the pools when the spec allows.

findings.title: swapOnUniswapV2Fork formats the packed uint256 pool word as an address.
findings.evidence: pools.[-1] uses lastPool (addressName), but each pool entry packs the address with direction and fee bits above bit 160.
findings.fix: Drop the field, or slice the low 20 bytes when the spec supports it.

findings.title: swapOnUniswapV2Fork output asset and ETH unwrap depend on pool state and the hidden weth parameter.
findings.evidence: The weth parameter has no field. The output token is read from the pair contract.
findings.fix: Show weth as a field to hint at native versus wrapped output.

Which selectors are registered on each chain (1, 56, 137) could not be checked.
There are no test cases, so no mined transaction or blind-reader result was available.
